svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: Items Board
svg.desc: Five more kit cards, each with its own damage and capacity ladders, for a figure carrying more than its player board holds. Generated by tools/build-board.mjs from data/itemboard.json, data/playerboard.json and data/components.json — do not edit. 297 x 210 mm at 8 units/mm, 3 mm bleed.

g.text: Each card is counted on the pair of ladders
